text: dsh-cliproxyapi-pro 是面向 DSH Web 的 CLIProxyAPI 模型插件。它连接 CPA 服务并发现模型目录，可把多个账号选中的模型同步到对话选择器。用户能在设置页管理账号、协议及模型参数，查看凭证额度，也可启用图片和视频生成命令。适合需要在 DSH 中使用 CPA 模型的用户；需连接 CPA 服务，账号密钥可在设置页填写，本机默认服务可自动发现。

dsh-cliproxyapi-pro syncs selected CPA models into DSH Web. Users can manage accounts and model settings, inspect quotas, and optionally generate or edit images and videos. A reachable CPA service is required; account keys are configured in settings.
想把 CLIProxyAPI 服务里的模型接入 DSH。
怎么在 DSH 对话的模型列表里使用 CPA 模型？
我需要在一个 DSH 配置里管理好几个模型代理账号。
能否让模型根据类型自动选用合适的请求协议？
哪里可以查看不同模型渠道的剩余额度？
我想通过 CPA 的模型生成图片或视频。
How do I sync models from a CPA server into DSH?
I want to check provider quotas and generate media from my DSH session.
dsh-cliproxyapi-pro 的功能「模型同步」：连接 CPA 后读取模型目录，将启用账号中选择的模型和路由配置同步到 DSH 模型选择器。
dsh-cliproxyapi-pro 的功能「渠道额度」：额度服务读取 CPA 凭证并生成额度快照，用户可查看账号额度并刷新状态。
dsh-cliproxyapi-pro 的功能「媒体生成」：开启生成功能后，可用 /cpa-image、/cpa-video 等命令生成或编辑媒体内容。

text:
dsh-cliproxyapi-pro README · 快速上手：1. **打开设置面板**：**设置** → 左侧导航的 **CLIProxyAPI** 页（账号、模型与协议都在这里）。插件自身的更新在左侧栏 **插件** → **CLIProxyAPI**，或 **设置** → **内置插件** → **CLIProxyAPI** 标签页，这两处只有更新功能。
2. **添加账号**：点 **+ 添加账号**，填账号名称、**服务地址**（如 `http://127.0.0.1:8317`，不用加 `/v1`）和 **API Key**（本地免密的 CPA 可留空），点 **连接**。连接成功即创建并启用账号；失败时会显示原因，可修正后重试，或选「仍然添加（不启用）」。
3. **选择模型**：在账号的 **模型** 标签里，CPA 上的全部模型已列出，并已为每个家族勾好最新的一个。按需增减后点底部的 **保存并应用**。
4. **开始使用**：回到对话框，打开模型选择器，就能在以账号名称命名的分组里看到这些模型。

CPA 就在本机默认端口 `8317` 且没有设置密钥时，什么都不用填，插件会自动发现它。

dsh-cliproxyapi-pro README · 截图：图 1–7 是离线组件渲染：用本插件的真实界面代码加示例数据（`example.com` 地址、虚构账号）在浏览器中渲染，配色按 DSH 深色主题近似，实际颜色跟随你的 DSH 主题。图 8 是 1.6.0 在 DSH 桌面版中的实际截图。

**1. 账号与连接。** 设置左侧导航的 **CLIProxyAPI** 页：顶部账号栏四个标签（连接 / 模型 / 生成 / 额度）共用；账号标题下是连接状态、地址和模型数，右侧「启用」开关立即生效，「⋯」菜单里是「立即探测刷新」和「删除此账号」。「连接」标签里每项一行，地址旁可「测试连接」（用正在编辑的值，不保存），次要说明在 ⓘ 里。

**2. 模型与统一保存。** 「模型」标签列出该 CPA 上的全部对话模型：全部 / 已勾选 / 未勾选、家族筛选、搜索、批量操作与「恢复推荐精选」；勾选的模型显示将使用的协议，可「编辑参数」。连接和模型的改动统一记录，底部出现「有未保存的更改 · 放弃更改 / 保存并应用」。

dsh-cliproxyapi-pro README · 截图：**3. 生图 / 生视频。** 「生成」标签顶部是总开关「启用图片和视频生成」（对所有账号生效，新安装默认关闭；关闭时这一页只剩这个开关，输入框旁的生成按钮和生成命令都不出现）。打开后分组列出生图 / 生视频模型，每个模型可单独开关、改类型；下面是标记漏识别的模型、保存位置、视频默认值和 agent 生成设置。

**4. 额度。** 「额度」标签：管理密钥、额度数据与刷新、凭证分布条，按渠道分组的凭证（套餐、前缀、状态、5 小时 / 每日 / 每周等额度条与重置时间；Devin 显示每日 / 每周额度，所有 Devin 模型共用；没有额度接口的渠道只显示状态与近期请求），以及可展开的「模型 → 渠道」表。标签上显示该账号可用凭证中最低的剩余额度。

**5. 管理密钥被拒绝。** 密钥连续 3 次被 CPA 拒绝（401/403）后停止自动查询，以免 CPA 封禁本机地址；页面说明原因，保留上次成功读取的数据。保存新的管理密钥后恢复，手动「刷新额度」只再试一次。

dsh-cliproxyapi-pro README · 截图：**6. 对话框里的额度。** 模型选择器左侧的徽标显示当前模型可用凭证中最充足的剩余额度；点击后列出服务该模型的每个凭证及其额度窗口。只对本插件同步、且所属账号已填写管理密钥的模型显示。

**7. 添加账号。** 填名称、地址和 API Key 后点「连接」：先测试，成功才创建并启用账号；失败时显示原因，可选「仍然添加（不启用）」。

**8. 内置插件里的插件更新页**（1.6.0 实际截图）。**设置** → **内置插件** → **CLIProxyAPI** 标签页只有插件更新：检查更新与离线下载、检测到 DSH 插件市场后的「立即更新」、更新通道、下载区域，以及自动检查 / 自动下载 / 自动安装开关。图中已是稳定通道最新版本，所以「立即更新」不可用。

**Bring the models of [CLIProxyAPI](https://github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI) (CPA) into the model picker of [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH).**

dsh-cliproxyapi-pro README · dsh-cliproxyapi-pro：Enter a server URL and an API key, and the plugin reads the CPA model catalog and synchronizes the models you check — with their context window, image input and reasoning levels — into DSH, each over the protocol that suits it best. Connect several CPA accounts at once and enable or disable each one on its own.

dsh-cliproxyapi-pro README · dsh-cliproxyapi-pro：- **Multiple accounts**: each account has its own URL, key, model selection and parameters, and can be switched off at any time. [Details](https://github.com/TinyBOOOOM/dsh-cliproxyapi-pro/blob/main/docs/en/accounts-and-models.md)
- **Works out of the box**: on the first connection, the newest model of each family in that server's own catalog is checked (at most 12), so the picker isn't flooded with hundreds of models. [Details](https://github.com/TinyBOOOOM/dsh-cliproxyapi-pro/blob/main/docs/en/accounts-and-models.md)
- **Native protocols**: Claude over Anthropic Messages, GPT / Codex / Grok over OpenAI Responses, everything else over OpenAI Chat — fewer protocol translations inside CPA. [Details](https://github.com/TinyBOOOOM/dsh-cliproxyapi-pro/blob/main/docs/en/accounts-and-models.md)
- **Visual management**: check models and edit per-model parameters in the settings panel. By default the plugin registers no agent tool, so it takes no model context (the optional generation tool `generate_media` is switched on in the Generation tab). [Details](https://github.com/TinyBOOOOM/dsh-cliproxyapi-pro/blob/main/docs/en/accounts-and-models.
dsh-cliproxyapi-pro README · dsh-cliproxyapi-pro：Works with DSH `0.2.0-rc.1` and later (desktop and web).

dsh-cliproxyapi-pro README · Option 1: the DSH Plugins page (recommended)：1. Open DSH and click **Plugins** in the left sidebar.
2. Click **Add plugin** at the top of the page.
3. Enter the package name:

```text
   dsh-cliproxyapi-pro
   ```

To pin a version, write `dsh-cliproxyapi-pro@1.9.1`.
4. Click **Install**. When it finishes, the dialog offers to enable the plugin right away — accept it.

> If downloads are slow in mainland China, open **Registry** next to the input and choose **the mainland China mirror**.

dsh-cliproxyapi-pro README · Option 2: ask the agent in DSH：Just say in a DSH conversation:

```text
Install the DSH plugin dsh-cliproxyapi-pro
```

The agent installs and enables it with `plugin_manager` (depending on your permission settings, it may ask for your approval). Then ask it to configure the plugin, e.g. "set the CLIProxyAPI URL to http://127.0.0.1:8317 with key sk-…".

dsh-cliproxyapi-pro README · Getting started：1. **Open the settings panel**: **Settings** → the **CLIProxyAPI** page in the left navigation (accounts, models and protocols live there). The plugin's own updates are on sidebar **Plugins** → **CLIProxyAPI** and on **Settings** → **Built-in plugins** → the **CLIProxyAPI** tab; those two places contain only update features.
2. **Add an account**: click **+ Add Account**, enter an account name, the **Base URL** (e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:8317`, without `/v1`) and the **API Key** (leave it empty for a local CPA without authentication), then click **Connect**. A successful connection creates and enables the account; on failure the reason is shown so you can fix it, or choose **Add Anyway (Disabled)**.
3. **Choose models**: the account's **Models** tab lists every model on the server, with the newest model of each family already checked. Adjust the selection and click **Save & Apply** at the bottom.
4. **Use them**: open the model picker in a conversation; the models appear in a group named after the account.
dsh-cliproxyapi-pro README · Getting started：If CPA runs on this machine on the default port `8317` without a key, there is nothing to fill in: the plugin finds it automatically.

dsh-cliproxyapi-pro README · Screenshots：**1. Accounts and connection.** The **CLIProxyAPI** page in the Settings dialog's left navigation: one account bar for all four tabs (Connection / Models / Generation / Quota); under the account title are the connection state, address and model count, with the **Enabled** switch (applies at once) and the **⋯** menu (**Probe & Refresh**, **Delete Account**) on the right. The **Connection** tab has one row per setting, **Test Connection** next to the address (uses the values being edited, saves nothing), and secondary explanations in ⓘ tips.

dsh-cliproxyapi-pro README · Screenshots：**2. Models and one save bar.** The **Models** tab lists every chat model on that CPA: All / Checked / Unchecked, family filter, search, bulk actions and **Reset to Recommended**; checked models show the protocol they will use and can be edited with **Edit Parameters**. Connection and model edits are tracked together, and a bar at the bottom shows **Unsaved changes · Discard / Save & Apply**.

dsh-cliproxyapi-pro README · Screenshots：**3. Image and video generation.** The top of the **Generation** tab holds the master switch **Enable image and video generation** (for every account, off on a new installation; while off this page shows only the switch, and neither the composer's generation buttons nor the generation commands exist). Once on, it lists image and video models in groups, each with its own switch and kind; below are marking missed models, the save location, video defaults and the agent generation settings.

dsh-cliproxyapi-pro README · Screenshots：**4. Quota.** The **Quota** tab: management key, quota data and refresh, a distribution bar, credentials grouped by channel (plan, prefix, status, 5-hour / daily / weekly meters with reset times; Devin shows its daily / weekly quota, shared by every Devin model; channels without a quota endpoint show status and recent requests only), and an expandable "Model → Channel" table. The tab label shows the lowest remaining quota among the account's usable credentials.

dsh-cliproxyapi-pro README · Screenshots：**5. A rejected management key.** After CPA rejects the key 3 times in a row (401/403), automatic checks stop so CPA does not ban this address; the page explains why and keeps the last data it read. Saving a new management key resumes them; a manual **Refresh Quota** tries only once.
